newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1997 inflation seen at 5.0 pct to 8.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1997 inflation seen at 5.0 pct to 8.0 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation rate is expected to reach between 5.0 percent and 8.0 percent in 1997, the Planning Ministry's Applied Economic Research Institute (Ipea) said.

In a bulletin detailing its predictions on GDP growth in 1996, Ipea said the figure the agency expected was 3.2 percent. In an earlier bulletin released today, the agency had put its estimate on GDP growth last year in the three-percent range.
The service sector led economic growth with a 3.9 percent hike in output, followed by agriculture with 3.3 percent and industry with 2.2 percent, the new bulletin said.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 507 4151))
